cards.text: The people have started rebuilding Jerusalem's broken wall, section by section (Nehemiah 3). Nehemiah, the king's cupbearer who came to Jerusalem to rebuild it, tells this story himself (Nehemiah 1:11; 2:5). And Sanballat the Horonite, who already mocked the plan once (Nehemiah 2:19), hears that the wall is actually going up.

cards.question: Sanballat hears the Jews are rebuilding the wall, and he is ___.

cards.text: So Sanballat starts ridiculing the Jews in front of his associates and the army of Samaria. Friend, this man didn't just heckle, he brought an AUDIENCE.

cards.question: Sanballat fires off question after question about the Jews and their wall. What's he really saying?

answers.text: They're building in the wrong place

cards.text: He even asks, “Will they complete it in a day?” Sanballat, NOBODY said a day, and I've got cookie boxes that take me longer than that!
Then Tobiah the Ammonite, standing right beside Sanballat, jumps in with a joke of his own about the wall.

cards.question: Tobiah jokes that even a fox climbing up on the Jews' wall would break it down.

cards.text: A FOX, out for a little evening stroll, and the whole wall comes down? Then Nehemiah turns to God: “Hear us, O God, for we are despised…”

cards.question: What does Nehemiah ask God to do with the scorn Sanballat and Tobiah are throwing at them?

answers.text: Turn it back on their own heads
Make the builders stronger through it

cards.question: Nehemiah asks God to let his enemies' sin be blotted out.
Nehemiah tells God why he's asking: they have provoked the ___.

cards.text: Meanwhile, the builders keep building. It's like when a coworker says “that'll never work” and the whole team just keeps right on going.

cards.question: How far does the wall get, with all of it joined together?

answers.text: All the way to the top

cards.question: What keeps the rebuilding of the wall moving like that?

answers.text: The people had a mind to work

cards.text: But news travels. Sanballat and Tobiah, together with the Arabs, Ammonites and Ashdodites, hear that the gaps in the wall are closing, and they are furious all over again.

cards.question: So what do Sanballat, Tobiah and all their allies plot together?

answers.text: To come and fight against Jerusalem
To offer to help finish the wall
To send a complaint to the king

cards.question: Nehemiah tells what they do about the threat: So we ___ to our God and posted a ___ against them.
The guard Nehemiah posts against the enemies only watches during the day.

cards.text: Now the talk comes from their own people. The people of Judah start speaking up about the work, so listen close, friend.

cards.question: What are the people of Judah saying about the work on the wall?

answers.text: There's too much rubble to ever finish
The wall is nearly finished now
The enemies have finally given up

cards.text: “The strength of the laborer fails,” they say, and friend, I hear that, because after one big batch I'm ready to lie down in the flour. Meanwhile, the enemies are talking too.

cards.question: When do the enemies say they'll strike the builders?

answers.text: Before the builders know or see a thing
Right after they send a warning
Once the wall is all finished

cards.text: Their plan is to come into the builders' midst, kill them, and put an end to the work.
Then the Jews who live nearby start showing up with a warning: “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”

cards.question: The Jews living nearby give Nehemiah and the others that warning ___ times over.

cards.text: TEN TIMES, friend, that's not a warning anymore, that's a group chat that will NOT stop buzzing. So Nehemiah makes a move.

cards.question: Where does Nehemiah station men to protect the city?

answers.text: Behind the lowest sections of the wall
On top of the tallest towers

cards.question: Nehemiah stations the men by themselves, away from their families.

cards.text: Nehemiah posts them with their swords, spears and bows. Then, after he looks everything over, he stands up in front of the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people.

cards.question: Nehemiah opens his speech about the enemies with this: Do not be ___ of them.
Nehemiah tells the people to remember the Lord, who is great and awesome. Who does he tell them to fight for?

answers.text: The king of Persia and his throne
Their own honor and their good name

cards.text: Then the enemies hear that their scheme has been found out. Turns out a sneak attack only works if it's, you know, SNEAKY.

cards.question: Nehemiah says God frustrated the enemies' scheme.
Once the enemies know their scheme is out, what does each of the builders do?

answers.text: Goes back to his own work on the wall
Marches out to attack the enemies

cards.text: From that day on, Nehemiah runs the job differently. His own servants get split right down the middle.

cards.question: Half of Nehemiah's servants did the ___ while the other half held ___, shields, bows, and armor.

cards.text: Officers stand behind the builders, and the ones hauling materials work with one hand and hold a weapon with the other. Friend, I can't carry a cookie box and set a timer at the same time, and I've got a MUSTACHE for extra hands.

cards.question: Each of the builders works on the wall with his sword left at home.

cards.text: Everybody's got a job. But one man stays right beside Nehemiah: the trumpeter.
Then Nehemiah points out the problem. The work is huge, and they're spread out far from one another along the wall.

cards.question: With the builders spread out along the wall, what does Nehemiah tell them to do when they hear the horn?

answers.text: Run back to their own homes
Climb to the top of the wall

cards.question: Nehemiah tells the builders that their God will fight for them.

cards.text: So the work keeps going, with half the men holding spears.

cards.question: How long do the builders and the spearmen keep at it?

answers.text: From dawn until the stars come out
Only through the dark of night

cards.text: Dawn to STARS, friend, while some of us hit snooze THREE times just to reach dawn. Then Nehemiah gives one more order.

cards.question: Nehemiah tells every man and his servant to spend the night inside ___.
Why does Nehemiah want every man and his servant staying in the city overnight?

answers.text: To stand guard by night and work by day
To rest up well before the next day
To keep the enemies from finding their homes

cards.text: And Nehemiah's own crew? His brothers, his servants and the guards with him are right in it with him.

cards.question: Nehemiah and the men with him don't even change out of their clothes.
Nehemiah and his crew carry their weapons even when they go where?

cards.text: Keep your apron on, friend. Nehemiah's story isn't over yet.
